messages:
Alyssa (AE): Acme POC signed (30d). They sent traffic profile: baseline 12 rps, 25 rps sustained windows (~20m), rare bursts ~90 rps for ~3m. p95 target <200ms. Need provisioning recommendation, pricing sketch, and security Q answers ASAP.

Jin (SE): Model size? quantized option? Token lengths?

Alyssa (AE): 13B open model. They'll try our 4-bit quantized for bursts if we recommend. Avg 1k tokens, ~5% at 5k tokens.

Ravi (SA): Quick capacity note: steady 12 rps -> ~1 A100-equivalent w/ batching. Sustained 25 rps -> reserve or autoscale to 2 nodes. 90 rps bursts require prewarm or fallback to quantized (2-3x throughput). Long tails drive GPU-seconds.

Marta (SRE): Ops patterns:
- Reserved: reserve 2 GPUs, autoscale floor 1 ceiling 3, keep 2 prewarm slots for bursts.
- Hybrid: reserve 1 GPU, allow shared burst with routing of long jobs to reserved-only. Expect higher tail latency on shared.

Ravi (SA): Recommend KV prefix caching to cut token work ~15-25%. Also route >3k-token requests to reserved queue only.

Jin (SE): Autoscale template:
- scale up if avg GPU util >70% for 30s
- scale down if <35% for 2m
- keep 2 prewarm instances

Marta (SRE): Runbook snippet for internal sim:
./loadgen --rps 12 --burst 90 --long-pct 5 --avg-tokens 1000 --long-tokens 5000 --dur 2h
I'll run this tomorrow.

Priya (Finance): Pricing sketch: reserved 2 GPUs for 30d = quote line. Burst minutes billed at 1.5x overage. Quantized option saves ~30% GPU time; include as optional line. I'll produce numbers in 24h.

Alyssa (AE): Security asks: customer KMS, SOC2, VPC/private support?

sec-bot (security-bot): KMS (customer-managed) = yes; SOC2 Type II (2024) = yes; VPC/Private deployment = supported via Redwood Private. See internal doc: https://internal.redwood/security/poc-answers

Jin (SE): Fallback policy: reserved -> quantized-4bit pool -> shared -> rate-limit. Also plan to early-stop or throttle very long jobs during bursts.

Ravi (SA): Action items: run sim + share latency heatmap; enable KV caching for POC; prepare autoscale config.

Marta (SRE): I'll prepare preheat config and on-call runbook steps to flip fallback routing.

Priya (Finance): Draft quote incoming in 24h.

Alyssa (AE): I'll confirm token mix and acceptance of quantized fallback with Acme and paste reply here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
